test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 31 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

t u _ _ x _ _ _ u u_ _ x y _ _ _ v x x _

options.text: u v x y u v x t u u y
u v x x t v x t u u y
u v x y t v x t u u y
u v x y t v x t u u u

solution:
Given: t u _ _ x _ _ _ u u_ _ x y _ _ _ v x x _

The logic here is: The repeated letters used are 'tuuvxxy'. A group of 7 letters is made.

First we will check all the options:

1) u v x y u v x t u u y → t u u v x x y - u u u v x x y - t u u v x x y

2) u v x x t v x t u u y → t u u v x x x - t u u v x x y - t u u v x x y

3) u v x y t v x t u u y → t u u v x x y - t u u v x x y - t u u v x x **y** 

4) u v x y t v x t u u u → t u u v x x y - t u u v x x y - t u u v x x u

So, in option 3 '__u v x y t v x t u u y__' is repeating itself.

Hence, the missing blanks are '__u v x y t v x t u u y'__.
